record_format_note: No record format exists in the repo/CLI yet; this follows the field lists in spec §5.7, §5.8, §5.9 and §9.4 (spec marks them a draft/sketch).

performance.id_note: Local id (folder + tag). NC has no Performance id registry yet.
performance.title: The C major Prelude, harmony only (after Bach, BWV 846): take 6 arps, 1/4 delay, hall 25%, LP 1 kHz
performance.performed_at_note: From the mtime of the WAV master (America/Los_Angeles, UTC-7).
performance.performer_id_note: NC has no system Identity for the engine yet.

performer.name: Astrid, NetComposer Algorithmic Performer (stand-in script on the box, not the netcomposer CLI)

rules_set_by.note: Effect parameters requested by Petrus in chat; chord matching and take selection are the script's rules.

composition_ref.version_note: Compositions are not versioned yet; the file hash pins the exact text.
composition_ref.music: Johann Sebastian Bach, Prelude in C major, BWV 846, Das Wohltemperierte Klavier I (1722). Public domain.

analysis.credit: Mark Gotham et al., When in Rome corpus

composition_ref.bass_check: Chord anchors and slash basses as in bars_v5.py (from the analysis; take 2 onward).

rule_set.name: bach-arps (BWV 846 take 6)

selection.match: chord per bar from bars_v5.py (dim7 any enharmonic spelling)
prefer: figure starts on its lowest note (-8)
small register jump (0.6x) and near MIDI 72 (0.4x)
selection.no_match: G7sus4 (bars 26, 30) built by layering Gsus4 + Csus4/G at -3 dB

rule_set.figuration: first 8 sixteenths of a 110 BPM up/down arp, time-stretched x1.5942 to a 69 BPM half bar, played on beats 1 and 3 (2nd at -0.72 dB; bar 35 2nd at -5.19 dB)

interpretation.summary: Effect chain requested in chat, applied to the take 6 arps performance.

turns.request: Then redo the Bach using them
Redo the arps bach with delay 1/4 40% feedback ,reverb 25%, LP 1000hz

crawl_snapshot.crawled_at_note: Read from the local site copy, not crawled live.

known_compromises.what: Layered substitution: G7sus4 = Gsus4 + Csus4/G (no 7sus4 recording)
G pedal under F#dim7: pedal is not a chord tone
C pedal under G7: no G7 arp has C as its lowest note
C major bars sit an octave high (C5-G5): the only C-major arp with C lowest is up there

hacks_chain.sync: 1/4 note, follows the tempo map (beat-mapped fractional delay)

hacks_chain.type: synthetic stereo hall IR, generated in the script (seeded noise, exponential decay); no external IR

hacks_chain.rule: ring out until -60 dB below peak (+0.3 s), 2.5 s fade into that point
